handoff: Ran 280 headless bot runs (8 seeds per set, same seeds) plus the test suite. Tests: 403 pass, 1 fail (B4 assertion stale vs named forecast). Median win cycle: no skills 28, logistics 20, research 23, expansion-only 26 (5/8), full tree 26 (only 6 of 12 skills affordable without a permit), always-expand 26, C1+permit 19, full tree+permit 30 (2/8 lose). Cosmetic or dead: C4 (unreachable before the only permit), C2 (net zero points), B1 (text). Weak: A5, B2, A2. False text: B3 routes, B4 naming, A2 storage. Harness bug fixed: --skills= learned everything (qa/bots/bot_run.gd, uncommitted). Decent equals always-expand in the harness, so dominance is untested. No crash, freeze or softlock. Details in qa/reports/2026-10-31-skill-tree-r1.json.
